meta.one_line: Real-browser render + playtest + 3-agent vision audit of 'A Duel Became a Crowd'. Page renders clean on desktop AND mobile: all 7 Vega/D3 charts + the online choropleth paint with real pixel area, hero video + poster + BGM card present, every referenced image is a real correctly-subjected photo, payload 3.97 MB, 0 real console errors. One in-place layout fix (hero kicker contrast). The 5 playtest hard-fails are all false positives (interactives verified working + keyboard-reachable in real Chrome) and are recorded as blocker_recorded with browser evidence.

advisory_notes: COUNT-UP (not a defect): the four stat callouts (5,726 / 632 / 97.4% / 85.5%) SETTLE to and hold their correct final values (Auditor settle-check confirmed; static span text is already correct, so JS-off safe). render_capture and the layout vision agent captured them mid-animation (5,707 / 1,181 / 188 / 24.6%) — a SCREENSHOT-TIMING artifact, NOT a data bug. Low-severity polish for the programmer: gate the count-up on prefers-reduced-motion (render the final immediately); the number is always correct regardless.

Charts polish (low, designer; lone single-agent opinions, not blocking): des_19 startup accent band lacks on-canvas '1984 private / 2006 startup' wave annotations (takeaway is legend-dependent); des_09 lacks direct bar value labels + a 2010s=171 / partial-2018 caveat callout; des_14 treemap has one tile labelled only '108' (no family name) + a few truncated labels (hover tooltips mitigate).

YouTube facade (low, programmer/designer; not blocking): des_21 uses , so the box is 0-height until the lazy thumbnail loads, then pops in (minor CLS). It DOES render correctly when scrolled to. Reserving 16:9 space (aspect-ratio) would remove the layout shift. Not edited (element is not broken; risk of disturbing a working facade).
Hero kicker contrast: fixed in place (see fixes[]).
